execute: Obtain the deployed host, method, path, content type, valid request schema and successful normal request. Trace the relevant sent-path transformation to route, validation, access decision and business result. Compare one justified variant while preserving other inputs. Use existing gateway logs, traces, handler-specific output or a static-page control to locate the observed layer; mark inferred layers. OpenAPI is a candidate template, not deployment proof. HTML/JSON, 200/400/405 or an exception class alone cannot locate the handler. A failed final request may still have earlier side effects.
review: Require request-to-handler linkage for reach and the disallowed result plus policy for impact. A traced static fallback or pre-handler rejection refutes reach for that variant. Ambiguous envelopes remain unknown. Stop variants sharing the evidenced failure; reopen for changed valid request, route map, normalization, handler evidence or deployment.
